item.title: UPESSC UP Headmaster Online Form 2026
item.description:
Post Name Total Posts Eligibility / Qualification
Headmaster (प्रधानाध्यापक) 1,172 Post Graduation / Master's Degree with minimum 50% marks from a recognized University and B.Ed. / B.P.Ed. from a recognized institution. Candidates must also have the prescribed teaching / Headmaster experience as mentioned in the recruitment notification.

For more details regarding eligibility, please read the official notification carefully.

item.title: UPESSC UP TGT Vacancy 2026
item.description:

TGT Hindi 2,791 Graduation with Hindi as a subject with 50% marks OR prescribed Post Graduation with 45% marks. B.Ed. and Upper Primary TET/CTET (Classes 6–8) as prescribed.

TGT Home Science 798 Graduation with Home Science with 50% marks OR prescribed Post Graduation with 45% marks. B.Ed. and Upper Primary TET/CTET as prescribed.
TGT Art / Drawing 775 Graduation in Art/Fine Arts with 50% marks OR prescribed Post Graduation with 45% marks. B.Ed. and Upper Primary TET/CTET as prescribed.

TGT Commerce 134 B.Com with 50% marks OR M.Com with 45% marks. B.Ed. and Upper Primary TET/CTET as prescribed.
TGT Urdu 103 Graduation with Urdu with 50% marks OR prescribed Post Graduation with 45% marks. B.Ed. and Upper Primary TET/CTET as prescribed.
TGT Music (Vocal) 87 Graduation/Post Graduation in Music with prescribed marks, or specified Sangeet Visharad/Prabhakar route with required degree, along with prescribed teacher-training qualification and Upper Primary TET/CTET.

TGT Music (Instrumental) 60 Graduation/Post Graduation in Music, or specified Sangeet Visharad/Prabhakar route with required degree, along with prescribed teacher-training qualification and Upper Primary TET/CTET.
